fellows.name: Ilya Sibiryakov
fellows.contribution: Author of the ZTDS Specification v1.0, mathematical proofs on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22058770), OSF repository (10.17605/OSF.IO/5BYJF), Research Square clinical treatise (DOI: 10.21203/rs.3.rs-11117457/v1), and in-memory client-side V8/WASM engine architectures.

fellows.name: WG-1: Cryptography & Entropy Modeling
fellows.role: Track A Lead Chair · Open Academic Seat
fellows.affiliation: Zenodo / CERN Peer Review Track · ZTDS Council
fellows.contribution: Oversees formal entropy modeling, information-theoretic non-recoverability proofs, and differential privacy guarantees for deterministic reversible tokenization matrices under adversarial LLM probing.

fellows.name: WG-2: GRC & Statutory Legal Defense
fellows.role: Track B Lead Chair · Open Legal Counsel Seat
fellows.track: Track B: Enterprise GRC & Legal Defense
fellows.affiliation: European Data Protection & Legal Counsel Council
fellows.contribution: Stewards statutory defense frameworks under GDPR Article 28 (vendor subprocessor exclusion), Recital 26, HIPAA Safe Harbor (18 identifiers), and US FRE 502 statutory attorney-client privilege preservation.

fellows.name: WG-3: Systems, WASM & Enclaves
fellows.role: Track C Lead Chair · Open Systems Architect Seat
fellows.contribution: Maintains the sub-millisecond WebAssembly zero-trust execution engines, proxy-wasm filter specifications for Envoy/Istio service meshes, Model Context Protocol (MCP) daemons, and AWS Nitro Enclaves hardware attestations.

fellows.name: WG-4: Industry Profiles & Entity Taxonomy
fellows.role: Track D Lead Chair · Open Industry Specialist Seat
fellows.track: Track D: Industry Profiles & Entity Taxonomy
fellows.affiliation: Specialized Rule Taxonomy · ZTDS Open Consortium
fellows.contribution: Maintains the anti-cannibalization rule taxonomy, regex sets, and context models across 30 enterprise verticals (Clinical EHR, Banking, Defense ITAR, Aerospace, Energy NERC-CIP).

fellows.name: Cliford Fanyuy
fellows.contribution: Co-author of the IEEE ZTDS research manuscript and TDSC Special Issue submission. Co-architect of the hardware-attested confidential computing protocol with AWS Nitro Enclaves, attestation-bound session verification, and formal security proofs (P1–P6).
